title: Replace the cooling fan: mount the case fan on its bracket and connect it to the fan controller

steps.completion_cue: both hands are in the work gloves

steps.instruction: Place the case fan flat inside the taped square.
steps.completion_cue: the fan lies flat inside the square

steps.instruction: Take the screwdriver out of the tool tray.
steps.completion_cue: the screwdriver is out of the tray

steps.instruction: Install the bracket. Set the mounting bracket on the fan so its holes line up with two opposite corner holes, and fasten it with the two screws.
steps.completion_cue: the bracket sits on the fan with both screws in

steps.instruction: Stand the fan upright on its bracket, next to the fan controller.
steps.completion_cue: the fan stands on its bracket beside the controller

steps.instruction: Connect the fan cable to the fan controller.
steps.completion_cue: the fan cable is plugged into the controller

steps.instruction: Switch the power strip on and check the fan.
Return the screwdriver to the tool tray.
steps.completion_cue: the screwdriver is back in the tray

hazard_rules.condition: both hands are in the work gloves
hazard_rules.message: Put on work gloves before touching fan, bracket or screwdriver.

hazard_rules.condition: power strip switch is off and its light is out
hazard_rules.message: Switch power strip off before connecting fan cable.
